name: Wooden Dangle Earrings With Hanging Charms
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    Crafted from premium 3mm wood with a smooth, high-quality finish. Each pair includes stainless steel earring hooks (2 cm) and connecting metal rings (0.8 cm), ensuring lightweight comfort and long-lasting durability. Hooks are available in silver or gold for your preferred look.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Each wooden charm measures approximately 1.5 × 1.5 inches ~ 3.81 × 3.81 cm
    - Two charms are connected vertically for a fun layered effect.
    - Charm thickness: 3mm
    - Earring hook: 2cm
    - Metal ring: 0.8cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    Designed with high-quality UV printing, the earrings feature crisp, vivid, and fade-resistant artwork. Both sides are printed for a professional, polished look from every angle.
     
  • Style Options:
    - Style 1: Features two connected charms — a charm on top paired with a charm below for a layered, eye-catching effect.

    - Style 2: Includes a main upper charm and a secondary hanging charm underneath, offering a playful and creative look. 📌 Note: Please leave at least 1.5 cm of space for attaching the lower charm when designing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Ideal for holiday events, daily wear, or festive photoshoots. Each pair is lightweight and comfortable for all-day use.
    - Optional gift box available in red, black, or white — perfect for retail display or ready-to-gift packaging.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    A charming and unique gift for anyone who loves creative accessories or festive fashion. Suitable for Christmas, birthdays, anniversaries, or any special occasion throughout the year.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Wooden Dangle Earrings With Hanging Charms

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
